title: C++ Exceptions in N-API/Electron Addons
description: Using C++ exceptions in N-API addons loaded into VSCode/Electron. C++ exceptions crash Electron instantly — there is no recovery. NAPI_DISABLE_CPP_EXCEPTIONS must be defined. All error handling in the addon must use return codes, napi_status checks, or napi_throw_error() for JS-visible errors. This also applies to any thirdparty library linked into the addon.
whenToUse: When writing or reviewing any C++ code that runs inside the N-API addon. When linking thirdparty libraries into the addon.
